entries.name: FeeHandlerRouter
entries.description: Routes bridge deposit fees to a configured fee handler for each token resource.

entries.name: AccessControlSegregator
entries.description: Stores one authorized address per bridge function selector. The authority for grantAccess can replace any function's authority, including unrestricted escrow withdrawal and access-control replacement.

entries.name: ZKFairValidiumDAC
entries.description: Committee attesting that data for a given dataRoot has been published. The DAC Owner can update the member set at any time.

members.description: URL and address of the DAC member

entries.name: Bridge
entries.description: Escrow holding ERC20 tokens and ETH for the configured bridge. Only that bridge can execute releases, withdraw funds or configure token mappings. Its own admin can set deposit limits.

_bridgeAddress.description: Bridge authorized to release or withdraw all escrow funds and configure token mappings.

entries.name: TokenBridge
entries.description: Routes token deposits and releases to asset handlers. Releases require an EIP-712 signature recovering to the configured signing address. The contract checks no source-chain proof or signer threshold. Per-function authorities can withdraw escrow funds, remap handlers and replace access control.

_MPCAddress.description: Address accepted by the ECDSA signature check. It is set once and cannot subsequently be replaced through endKeygen.

_accessControl.description: Contract defining authority for each administrative function, including unrestricted escrow withdrawals.

usdcHandler.description: Handler holding USDC for resource ID zero.

ethHandler.description: Handler holding ETH for resource ID one.

receivedPermissions.description: authorize trusted forwarders that can impersonate administrative callers by appending their address to calldata.
remap token resources and their handlers in the bridge.
replace every per-function bridge authority, including authority to withdraw all escrow funds.
set per-token limits on individual and daily deposits.
authorize arbitrary token releases by signing bridge proposals.
withdraw all escrow funds through the bridge's adminWithdraw function.
